source: OpenRouter's documented 429 envelope (docs: limits, 'Handling 429 errors', read 2026-10-04) with the X-RateLimit-* headers the docs say a platform-limit 429 carries. The message names the limit, free-models-per-day, which is the name ARC-8 keys on; the live smoke does not spend a request to provoke one.

error.message: Rate limit exceeded: free-models-per-day. Add 10 credits to unlock 1000 free model requests per day
